City Council

la puente City Council
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
JUNE 23, 2009
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCILMEMBERS: Mendoza, Solis, Storing, Holloway, Lujan
COMMISSIONERS: Mendoza, Solis, Storing, Holloway, Lujan
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF PROCLAMATION FOR PARKS & RECREATION MONTH
Proclamation
PRESENTATION OF AWARDS TO THE CITY OF LA PUENTE FOR:
* DISTINGUISHED BUDGET PRESENTATION AWARD - GOVERNMENT FINANCE OFFICERS ASSOCIATION
Award
* EXCELLENCE IN OPERATING BUDGETING FISCAL YEAR 2008-2009 - CALIFORNIA SOCIETY OF MUNICIPAL FINANCE OFFICERS
Certificate
* CERTIFICATE OF ACHIEVEMENT FOR EXCELLENCE IN FINANCIAL REPORTING - GOVERNMENT FINANCE OFFICERS ASSOCIATION

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Community Development Commission on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
RECESS COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE:
a.)
REGULAR MEETING OF JUNE 9, 2009
Minutes 6-09-09 CC Reg
b.)
SPECIAL MEETING OF JUNE 9, 2009
Minutes 6-09-09 CC Spc
c.)
SPECIAL MEETING OF JUNE 11, 2009
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of June 9, 2009 and Special Meetings of June 9, 2009, and June 11, 2009.
Minutes 6-11-09 CC Spc
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
None.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF AWARDING TWO ADDITIONAL SCHOLARSHIPS FOR ACADEMIC YEAR 2009-2010
It is recommended by the Education Commission that the City Council not award any further scholarships. However, Mayor Pro Tem Holloway and Council Member Solis requested this issue be given further consideration and funds be transferred from Travel and Mileage Account.
Additional Scholarship Report
C-2
CONSIDERATION OF AGREEMENT FOR CITY ATTORNEY SERVICES WITH OLIVAREZ & HOGAN, P.C.
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agreement with Olivarez & Hogan, P.C. and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement on its behalf.
Attorney Services with Olivarez & Hogan Report
Attach A
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1252 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2008-09
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 09-4807.
City WR # 1252
D-2
APPROVAL OF TREASURER'S/FINANCIAL REPORT FOR THE MONTH ENDED MAY 31, 2009
It is recommended that the City Council receives and files the Monthly Treasurer's/Financial Report for the month ended on May 31, 2009.
Treasurer's/Financial Report 5-31-09
Attach A - G
D-3
APPROVAL OF INVESTMENT POLICY FOR FISCAL YEAR 2009-2010
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 09-4808 adopting City of La Puente Statement of Investment Policy for the Fiscal Year 2009-10 and designating the City Treasurer as its Investment Officer.
Investment Policy FY 09-10 Report
Attachment A
Exhibit A of Attach A
D-5
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY REPORT FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM FY 2008-09
It is recommended that the City Council approve the CDBG Housing Program Summary report and authorize that it be filed for audit.
CDBG Housing Rehabilitation Report
Attachments A - B
D-6
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY REPORT FOR CALHOME HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM ROUND 4 FUNDS
It is recommended that the City Council approve the CalHome Housing Program Summary report and authorize that it be filed for audit.
CalHome Housing Rehabilitation Report
Attchments A - B
D-7
APPROVAL OF THE AMERICAN RECOVERY AND REINVESTMENT ACT OF 2009 JUSTICE ASSISTANCE GRANT (JAG) AWARD
It is recommended that the City Council approve the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the City of Los Angeles for the administration of the Justice Assistance Grant funds.
Justance Assistance Grant (JAG) Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
Attachment C
D-8
ADOPTION OF CHAPTER 3.70 RELATING TO REGULATION OF CAMPING WITHIN THE CITY (Introduced and title read at meeting of June 9, 2009)
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Ordinance No. 09-886 adding Chapter 3.70, Title 3, pertaining to Camping, to the La Puente Municipal Code.
Regulation of Camping Report
Attachment A
D-9
APPROVAL OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE CHAPTER 3.20 PERTAINING TO PUBLIC NUISANCES (Introduced and title read at meeting of June 9, 2009)
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Ordinance No. 09-887 amending Chapter 3.20, Title 3, of the La Puente Municipal Code.
Public Nuisances Report
Attachment A
D-10
APPROVAL OF A RESOLUTION SUPPORTING THE CITY OF DIAMOND BAR AND CITY OF INDUSTRY'S EFFORTS TO SECURE FUNDING TO IMPROVE THE STATE ROUTE 57/60 FREEWAY INTERCHANGE
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 09-4810 supporting the needed improvements to the State Route 57 and State Route 60 Freeway Interchange.
State Route 57/60 Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
Attachment C
D-11
ACCEPTANCE OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR THE COMMUNITY CENTER/YOUTH LEARNING ACTIVITY CENTER PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) accept the project as complete and 2) authorize staff to execute the Notice of Completion.
Community Ctr / Youth Learning Activity Ctr Report
Attachment A
D-12
ACCEPTANCE OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR THE CITYWIDE STRIPING AND PAVEMENT MARKINGS
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) accept the project as complete; and 2) authorize staff to execute the Notice of Completion.
Citywide Striping and Pavement Markings Report
Attachment A
D-13
ACCEPTANCE OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR THE SLURRY SEAL ZONE 6 PROJECT (CDBG NO. 601133-08)
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) accept the project as complete; and 2) authorize staff to execute the Notice of Completion.
Slurry Seal Zone 6 Reports
Attachment A
D-14
ACCEPTANCE OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR THE INSTALLATION OF HANDICAPPED CURB RAMPS
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) accept the project as complete; 2) approve final project cost including change orders; and 3) authorize staff to execute the Notice of Completion.
Handcapped Curb Ramps Reports
Attachment A
D-15
APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION FOR A LOAN FROM THE CITY GENERAL FUND TO THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION CAPITAL PROJECTS FUND FOR ADMINISTRATIVE AND OTHER COSTS FOR REDEVELOPMENT PROJECTS
It is recommended that the Council adopt Resolution No. 09-4811 and approve the loan agreement.
Loan from City General Fund Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING THE CITY'S FISCAL YEAR 2009-2010 ANNUAL BUDGET IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE ADOPTION OF THE CITY'S GANN APPROPRIATION LIMIT AND ESTABLISHING CONTROLS ON CHANGES IN APPROPRIATIONS FOR THE VARIOUS FUNDS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 09-4809, approving the City's Annual Budget and Appropriation Limit for Fiscal Year 2009-2010.
City's FY 09-10 Annual Budget Report
Attach A - F
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 5.04.200 OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE PERTAINING TO APPLICATIONS FOR BUSINESS LICENSES
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) Waive first reading of Ordinance No. 09-888 and read by title only; and 2) Introduce Ordinance No. 09-888 an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente Amending Section 5.04.200 (Application for Business License) of Chapter 5.04 (Licenses) of Title 5 (Business Regulation and Licenses) of the City of La Puente Municipal Code to amend the identification requirements.
Applications for Business Licenses Report
Attachment A
E-2
AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT NO. 04-777 FOR PROVISION OF TRANSIT SERVICES INCLUDING DIAL-A-RIDE SERVICES BETWEEN CITY OF LA PUENTE AND SOUTHLAND TRANSIT, INC.
It is recommended that the City Council extend the contract with Southland Transit, Inc. for the provision of dial-a-ride and fixed-route transit services for one additional year ending June 30, 2010 and authorize the Mayor to execute the contract amendment on behalf of the City.
Transit Services Including Dial-A-Ride Report
Attachment A
Attachment B
E-3
APPROVAL OF A LICENSE AGREEMENT BETWEEN CITY OF LA PUENTE AND NORTHROP GRUMMAN SPACE & MISSION SYSTEMS CORPORATION TO INSTALL AND MAINTAIN WATERLINES AND EXTRACTION WELLS
It is recommended that the City Council approve the license agreement between the City of La Puente and Northrop Grumman to install and maintain water lines and extraction wells within certain public rights of way of the City.
Northrop Space & Mission Systems Corp. Report
Attachment A
E-4
APPROVAL OF A LICENSE AGREEMENT BETWEEN CITY OF LA PUENTE AND UNITED TECHNOLOGIES/CARRIER CORPORATION TO INSTALL AND MAINTAIN WATERLINES AND EXTRACTION WELLS
It is recommended that the City Council approve the license agreement between the City of La Puente and United Technologies/Carrier to install and maintain water lines and extraction wells within certain public rights of way of the City.
United Technologies/Carrier Corp. Report
Attachment A
E-5
CONSIDERATION OF AGREEMENT FOR CITY ATTORNEY SERVICES WITH MEYERS, NAVE, RIBACK, SILVER, AND WILSON TO COMPLETE CURRENT ASSIGNMENTS FOR THE CITY OF LA PUENTE
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agreement with Meyers, Nave, Riback, Silver, and Wilson and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement on its behalf.
Attorney Services - Meyers Nave Report
Attachment A
